# Detect heteroscedasticity patterns from fitted model

<small>Source: [`R/intelligent_recommendations.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/intelligent_recommendations.R) · Help: `?identifyVariancePatterns`</small>

Detect heteroscedasticity patterns from fitted model

## Usage

```r
identifyVariancePatterns(model, data)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   Fitted `lm`/`glm` object.

`data`
:   Data used to fit the model.

## Value

A list describing detected patterns and recommended remediation
tactics.
